name: Singular People, S.A.
summary: Singular People, S.A. specializes in the full lifecycle of technology-driven transformation projects and digital products, from initial concept and creation through to implementation and market visibility. The company provides these services to businesses across Spain and in international markets. Its diverse client portfolio encompasses sectors such as energy and utilities, financial services, healthcare, manufacturing, cultural institutions (museums), public administration, retail, and telecommunications and media. Established in 2014, Singular People, S.A. maintains its primary operations in Madrid, Spain.
